judgment_basis: SAS-generated 1:1 randomization was reported, but allocation concealment was not; no blinding was used for the patient-reported 0-pad outcome. Reported continence percentages correspond to the full randomized denominators at each time point, so missing outcome data were judged low risk. No prospective protocol or prespecified analysis plan was located. All stated continence time points and both unadjusted and adjusted results were reported; numerical inconsistencies were treated as reporting uncertainty rather than evidence that a result was selected. Multiple domains with some concerns were judged to substantially lower confidence, yielding Overall High.
reviewer_status: Dual review and Yang adjudication established Overall High; a subsequent statistical-method audit reclassified D5 from High to Some concerns without changing the overall judgement
